terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of our website and services. By using the service, you agree to be bound by these terms.

liability.heading: 4. Limitation of Liability
liability.body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the service.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our service.

collection.heading: 1. Information We Collect
collection.body: We may collect information you provide directly, such as account details, as well as data collected automatically, such as usage and device information.

use.heading: 2. How We Use Information
use.body: We use collected information to provide, maintain, and improve the service, to communicate with you, and to comply with legal obligations.

sharing.heading: 3. Sharing of Information
sharing.body: We do not sell your personal data. We may share information with service providers who process it on our behalf, or when required by law.

rights.heading: 4. Your Rights
rights.body: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, or delete your personal data. Contact us to exercise these rights.

contact.heading: 5. Contact Us
contact.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through the channels provided on our website.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them, and the choices you have.

what.heading: 1. What Are Cookies
what.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help websites function and remember information about your visit.

types.heading: 2. Types of Cookies We Use
types.body: We use essential cookies required for the service to function, as well as optional cookies for analytics and preferences.

manage.heading: 3. Managing Cookies
manage.body: You can control and delete cookies through your browser settings. Disabling some cookies may affect how the service works.

changes.heading: 4. Changes to This Policy
changes.body: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with a revised date.
